'''Bootlegger's Market''' was a sprawling marketplace around which the trading port section of [[Raider's Cove]] was built. Like the rest of the trading port, the market was built on pylons holding it above the often-flooded coastline, and the market sprawled across a number of wooden platforms and buildings.
